defect.reproducer: Запуск simulation.launch.py с bridge_config, указывающим на bridge-broken-imu.yaml. ROS IMU не поступает: ограниченный echo завершился с кодом 124. См. defect.md и defect-before.txt.
defect.root_cause: Для ROS /vehicle/imu мост подписан на ошибочный Gazebo-топик /vehicle/imu_typo вместо /vehicle/imu.
defect.proof_after: После перезапуска с основным bridge.yaml получена ROS IMU с frame_id=imu_link; echo завершился с кодом 0. См. defect-after.txt.

limitations: Headless operation and sensor output were verified, but headless.txt records bridge exit code -11 during shutdown; clean shutdown is not claimed.
Replay of the final fixture has not been verified.
Large bag recordings are retained locally; their transfer is separate from Git evidence.
